settings.title: Treat the cases already in your chair to their full potential.

settings.editor: A 12-month online programme that gives general dentists the clinical framework to assess, plan, and deliver complex aesthetic cases in full: composite artistry, smile design, indirect restorations.
Structured case-planning. 1:1 clinical support from UK faculty. Built on an evidence-based, UK-accredited foundation.
Suitable for:  •  Graduate dentists  •  NHS dentists  •  Private dentists  •  Practice owners

You’re already seeing these patients.


The worn anteriors. The discoloured composites that have never quite matched. The patient who points at their smile and says can we do something about all of this?


You can treat them. But often, you only treat part of it. Perhaps just a single tooth when all anteriors need addressing. Whitening when more intervention was justifiable. Something very conservative when the patient was ready for something more comprehensive.


It’s not about ability. It’s that aesthetic cases don’t arrive with a clear framework the way simpler restorative ones do — no agreed sequence for full-arch planning, no structured approach to reading occlusion into a smile case, no formal training in how to build and present a treatment plan that genuinely addresses what the patient came in for.


So you do what you can confidently justify. And the patient leaves with something, rather than everything they needed, or wanted.

settings.title: Build the clinical framework to treat aesthetic cases in full

settings.editor: Over 12 months, you build the clinical framework to assess, plan, and deliver aesthetic cases in full — with the confidence to propose treatment that properly meets what your patients are asking for.
Develop a structured approach to full-arch aesthetic assessment — so you can see and plan the complete case, not just the presenting complaint
Build confidence in treatment sequencing — when to whiten first, when indirect restorations are the right call, how occlusion shapes every aesthetic decision
Present comprehensive treatment plans patients understand and accept — and charge accordingly
Deliver high-quality composite artistry, indirect restorations, and more — with 1:1 clinical support from expert faculty
Build on a UK-accredited, evidence-based foundation — not short courses with no follow-up
“Opting for LDI for my Aesthetic and Restorative Dentistry diploma was one of the most significant career choices I have made. I would highly recommend this course.”
General Dentist, LDI - PG Dip. Alumnus

settings.title: Can you really learn Aesthetic & Restorative Dentistry online?

settings.editor: The programme combines online theory with a comprehensive Clinical Simulation Kit and 1:1 case support from our expert tutors. You receive the models and equipment needed to practise hands-on techniques at home, alongside live Zoom study clubs and optional in-person workshops in London.
models and equipment for composite, indirect restoration, and clinical photography practice, shipped to you
apply new techniques to your own patients with tutor feedback through the VLE
live Zoom sessions with faculty, with recordings on the VLE if you miss them
